items.title: Stop H and Stop P, with their resolutions

declared.bar: per statistic S: dShip = |S_ship - S_nat|, dCand = |S_cand - S_nat|; pass iff dCand <= dShip + res; a cell passes only if every statistic passes; a statistic with no support, or a population cell the candidate lacks, is UNMEASURED and never a pass; a stop passes only if every cell passes

stopH.population: 16 cells: every calibration / validation impulse scene in the four standard macOS 27 profiles, tinted included, WebGPU
stopH.reading: Rec.709 luma of encoded codes around each admitted dot's backdrop centroid: peak = mean(r < 2) - median(8 <= r < 10), annulus = mean(2 <= r < 8) - median(8 <= r < 10), and floor = median(8 <= r < 10) in absolute codes (G9, declaration v2); the median over admitted dots; a cell passes only if all three pass
stopH.admission: the whole r < 10 disc at depth >= 2 CSS px and the centroid past the lens extent 1.337 min(0.25 span, 20): one dot per shape, (160, 104) on the capsule and rrect-md

stopP.population: 26 cells: every untinted calibration / validation photo scene in the four standard profiles, WebGPU (M1 / M2's bed)
stopP.reading: OKLab (a, b) of the encoded image over the deep body, depth >= max(6, min(16, half the inradius)); bands F = G(1) - G(4) and M = G(4) - G(16) CSS px, Gaussians normalised to the region; E = sqrt(mean(Da^2 + Db^2))
stopP.resolution: per cell, frozen in the declaration: the band energy of the difference of two independent one-code roundings at the native image's colours, 0.12-0.28 x 1e-3 on F and 0.032-0.074 x 1e-3 on M

items.clause: 11; X26 as carried, X33, X40; Decision Log 3

declared.runner: bed/exposure/runner.py imports W41's X26 runner unchanged and derives the W42 boundary, scope, pins, freeze, verify and verdict
declared.binding: ONE receipt binds the identified law (the structure through native T: parameters, numerical predictions, calibration / validation survival), candidate 1 (landed T, required) and at most one candidate 2 (native T), each with its numerical composition and blind rendered H predictions (PNG and projection) frozen by hash before the receipt and recaptured equal inside it

declared.closure: the law closes iff every measured H cell of every claimed endpoint passes at max(1 code, bar), with at least one measured H cell per claimed endpoint; a censored H cell is UNMEASURED and counts toward neither pass nor coverage, the measured coverage reported; candidate 2 is scored against Apple's H pixels, candidate 1 against its own frozen structure-with-landed-T prediction with levelMiss recorded; a candidate is landable only if the law closes and its own check passes; X40 selects candidate 2 if landable, else candidate 1, else none
declared.claimedEndpoints: frozen, a nonempty subset; unclaimed endpoints scored and reported 'not claimed (identity)' (Decision Log 3)
declared.spend: any fault after begin spends H; nothing changes after the receipt
declared.productionPins: production-pin.json: G1 pins the archive inventory; declare.py hash pins this declaration and its closure (closure.json, written from items survivalBars and exposureRunner)
declared.proof: 26 red against a stub, 27 green on a synthetic H; with b9's cross-checkout claim the runner suite reads 34 of 34
declared.crossCheckout: before begin the runner fetches origin's tags and refuses if the receipt log path has history on any ref or the marker tag exists; it then pushes an annotated marker tag (w42-h-exposure) atomically, so of two racing checkouts one exposes H and the other refuses (b9)
